title: Area-code org enumeration shard A pass 25

data.research_question: Which current public anarchist, anti-authoritarian, autonomous, Food Not Bombs, mutual-aid, collective and closely adjacent organizations are discoverable in shard-A NPAs 732, 738, 747 and 762?
data.method: Deterministic NPA shard-A enumeration using current NANPA authority, literal area-code and organization-family queries, locality-derived searches, current-status verification, repository dedupe, historical-lead checks, first-party/public-directory corroboration, and public organizational communications enumeration.
classification_rules: Use current in-service U.S. NANP geographic NPAs where integer(NPA) mod 3 == 0.
Historical directories and old event pages are discovery seeds and do not establish current activity without fresh corroboration.
Area-code relations represent locality/discovery geography and do not assert telephone-number ownership.
Reuse canonical organization identities when already present; do not merge organizations from name or handle similarity alone.
Preserve ideological characterization only when supported by organizational self-description or source evidence.
No private membership inference or person-level political/ideological affiliation profiling.

unresolved_leads: Central Jersey Mutual Aid Resources remains a broad social-group/directory lead requiring distinct organizational identity resolution.
Historical Middlesex-area mutual-aid seeds were not promoted without current organizational evidence.
Additional 213/323/738 mutual-aid projects surfaced but were left for separate identity resolution rather than duplicating broad Los Angeles records.
The People's Struggle SFV has recent public disaster-relief evidence but insufficient first-party organizational identity resolution in this bounded pass.
Athens Housing Advocacy Team appears jointly on the current Open Collective project but identity separation was left unresolved rather than silently splitting or merging it.
Historical Athens Food Not Bombs leads lacked sufficient current-status corroboration in this bounded pass.
